references.text: Theological contrast between receiving a name through God's blessing (Ruth) and building a name for oneself through human rebellion (Babel).
Contrast between a prayer of faith for God's 'great work' (Ruth) and a challenge of doubt to see God's 'work' (Isaiah).
Direct thematic parallel: Blessing of a woman who will become the matriarch of Israel's house and take possession of the 'gates' (Ruth and Rebekah).
